evidence: Visual is diffuse light-gray translucent haze over dark ocean in a gap between brighter white clouds, distinct from cumulus/cirrus; mask is 0% over land (E4) with 119 km length and 4321 km2 area (E6), so ocean haze, not land artifact. [E4, E6]

Kilauea is ADVISORY/YELLOW episodic_pause after Oct 17 episode 55 with next episode forecast Nov 1-7, Mauna Loa NORMAL/GREEN not erupting (E2); FIRMS shows no fire clusters, only Kilauea summit volcanic thermal glow (E3), arguing against active vog or wildfire smoke. [E2, E3]

Geometry shows no vent connection: centroid 204.5 km to Kilauea and 170.6 km to Mauna Loa (E6), wind-based upwind end still 164.6 km and 129.8 km away (E7), and motion-inferred source end 248.5 km and 215.5 km southwest over open ocean (E5). [E6, E7, E5]

Transport story fails: wind at centroid from 81 deg (toward 261 deg WSW) (E1) vs measured drift toward 63 deg ENE (E5) differs by ~162 deg, strong disagreement; wind at tracked source end from 176 deg (toward 356 deg) (E8) vs 63 deg still differs by ~67 deg, outside 45-deg tolerance, lowering confidence. mauna_loa.activity_summary: Mauna Loa earthquake counts decreased in September compared to August, and minor inflation continues. Mauna Loa had a decrease in seismic activity compared to the previous month; a total of 53 earthquakes were detected in Mauna Loa's summit region during the September reporting period, after 87 in August. Most earthquakes occurred deep beneath the upper Southwest Rift Zone or broadly scattered around the upper flanks.
